art_direction: 宽眼上缘像低拱桥，双瞳正视，留白为缺边的宽小方片但眼角圆收。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Draw broad eye openings under low bridge-like marker arches. Keep the eye corners curved and short, with no rectangular outline. Both substantial pupils look forward. Reserve a broad roughly quadrilateral paper patch in each pupil, breaking one edge into an uneven notch. One upper stroke should thicken a little earlier than the other. Add brief lower arcs and compact flat iris accents. The expression comes from steady pupil placement, not extra marks. Center the eyes with no brows or mouth.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
